symptom: CE consumed three physical LLM calls and produced two schema-valid, unique test-artifact upserts, but semantic composition rejected both as duplicate obligation ids.

exact_run_evidence.terminal_hint: chief_engineer.semantic_patch_invalid:ValueError:semantic repair would create duplicate obligation ids

root_cause.confirmed: The repair composer required absolute global obligation-id uniqueness after every patch. The frozen schema-valid CE candidate intentionally used OBL-MAIN-RS in both artifact and entrypoint collections to link two views of one delivery fact. Neither typed patch introduced a duplicate, but the unconditional guard blamed that pre-existing relation.

fix.policy: Compare before and after cross-collection obligation-id multiplicities and reject only duplicates introduced or increased by the patch. Per-collection duplicate ids remain rejected by _replace_by_id, and a new cross-collection collision still fails closed.

verification.fresh_r06: The duplicate-obligation terminal signature disappeared. CE reached a fourth typed repair call and exposed an atomic test-depth versus cross-task behavior-coverage diagnosis gap.
